newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore Cty, Md., to vote on $89.6 mln GO bonds.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore Cty, Md., to vote on $89.6 mln GO bonds.

text.p: Baltimore County, Md., has scheduled a Nov 5 referendum on $89.6 million of general obligation bonds for schools, Baltimore Sun reported Thursday.
The bond proposal is part of a six-year, $310 million capital spending plan unveiled Wednesday. The plan calls for enough new schools to accommodate 5,400 additional students over six years.
County school officials said they expect the bond referendum to pass, but will also ask the state for $36.8 million in fiscal 1997 to build and renovate 19 schools.
